metadata.source: U.S. Census Bureau ACS 5-Year Data Profiles & Essex County 2026 Certified Rolls

zipCodeComparison.neighborhoodsIncluded: Brookdale Section, Bloomfield Center & Watsessing Transit District, Fairview & Broughton Section, Oak View & Demarest District
keyFindings: Certified composite property tax rate is 3.82%, with an equalization ratio of 65.2%.
Public education represents 53.4% of property taxes, while municipal operations account for 30.2%.
Average residential assessment is $322,740, producing an average annual tax bill of $12,328.67.

neighborhoods.name: Brookdale Section
neighborhoods.character: Premier northern residential neighborhood with spacious single-family homes, colonials, and split-levels adjacent to Brookdale Park
neighborhoods.description: Prestigious northern section bordering Montclair, anchored by the 121-acre Brookdale Park designed by the Olmsted Brothers firm.
neighborhoods.taxDynamic: Highest residential assessed values in Bloomfield, bearing substantial portion of the local school district levy.

neighborhoods.name: Bloomfield Center & Watsessing Transit District
neighborhoods.character: Urban downtown core surrounding Bloomfield Green, historic college campus, and transit-oriented luxury apartment mid-rises
neighborhoods.description: Rapidly evolving downtown core surrounding Bloomfield NJ Transit train station, Bloomfield College of Montclair State University, and new mixed-use developments.
neighborhoods.taxDynamic: Multiple active 30-year PILOT agreements where developers pay service fees rather than standard school/muni taxes.

neighborhoods.name: Fairview & Broughton Section
neighborhoods.character: Established residential neighborhood featuring post-war cape cods, ranches, and traditional two-family homes
neighborhoods.description: Family neighborhood convenient to local parks, community elementary schools, and Garden State Parkway exits.
neighborhoods.taxDynamic: Representative baseline of Bloomfield residential properties (~$370,000 average assessment).

neighborhoods.name: Oak View & Demarest District
neighborhoods.character: Quiet suburban streets with attractive single-family residences, brick colonials, and landscaped yards bordering Glen Ridge
neighborhoods.description: Desirable suburban residential enclave offering walkability to Oak View Elementary School and Glen Ridge commuter rail.
neighborhoods.taxDynamic: Stable ratable base with very low tax delinquency and high owner occupancy.

equityAnalysis.summary: Bloomfield Township maintains a certified residential tax roll across its neighborhoods.

keyTakeaways.title: Property Tax Burden & Household Income
keyTakeaways.detail: In Bloomfield Township, homeowners pay an average of $12,328.67 annually in property taxes, consuming approximately 12.55% of median household income.

keyTakeaways.title: Equalization Ratio & Revaluation Balance
keyTakeaways.detail: With an equalization ratio of 65.2%, assessed values average ~65.2% of current true market values, establishing the basis for certified county tax equalization.

keyTakeaways.title: School District vs Municipal Levy Split
keyTakeaways.detail: Local education represents 53.4% of the total tax bill, municipal government absorbs 30.2%, and Essex County claims 16.4%.
